phase_boots.description: +18 damage, +4 armor. Active: +22% move speed for 3s (CD 8s).
phase_boots.coaching_tip: Use Phase active both offensively for chasing and defensively for escaping. Short cooldown means you should spam it whenever moving across the map.

power_treads.description: +25 selected attribute, +45 attack speed. Toggle between Str/Agi/Int.
power_treads.coaching_tip: Switch to Int before casting spells to save mana, then switch to Str when taking damage for survivability. Tread-switching is a core efficiency skill.

arcane_boots.description: Active: Restore 175 mana to nearby allies (CD 55s).
arcane_boots.coaching_tip: Pop Arcane Boots before teamfights to top off your team's mana. Coordinate with teammates so multiple Arcane Boots aren't used at the same time.

tranquil_boots.description: +65 move speed. Passive: 16 HP regen when not broken. Breaks for 13s on attack or taking hero damage.
tranquil_boots.coaching_tip: Attacking or taking player damage breaks the regen for 13 seconds. Best on roaming supports who need sustain between ganks without returning to base.

travel_boots.description: Active: Teleport to any friendly building or creep. +32 move speed.
travel_boots.coaching_tip: Core item for split-pushing and global map pressure. Use it to join fights across the map and then TP back to push a side lane while the enemy regroups.

guardian_greaves.description: Active: Restore HP and mana to nearby allies, self-dispel on cast. Bonus aura below 20% HP.
guardian_greaves.coaching_tip: The self-dispel on activation is extremely valuable. The bonus healing/armor aura kicks in when allies are below 20% HP, making it a critical teamfight item. Use it before your team gets too low.

black_king_bar.description: Spell Immunity. +10 Str, +24 damage. Duration decreases from 9s to 6s with each use.
black_king_bar.coaching_tip: Duration shrinks each use, so save BKB for the most critical teamfight moments. Do not waste it on small skirmishes. Activate it when committing to a fight, not preemptively.

glimmer_cape.description: Active: Invisibility and +50% magic resistance on target ally or self for 5s.
glimmer_cape.coaching_tip: Can be cast on allies -- use it to save teammates being focused. The magic resistance bonus applies even if the enemy has detection, so it still has value in those situations.

ghost.description: Active: Enter ethereal form for 4s. Immune to physical attacks but take 40% extra magic damage.
ghost.coaching_tip: Excellent against physical burst heroes like PA, Ursa, or Troll. However, beware of magic nukers -- the 40% amplified magic damage can get you killed faster. Don't use it against heavy magic lineups.

force_staff.description: Active: Push target unit 600 distance in the direction they are facing.
force_staff.coaching_tip: Use it to save allies, escape over cliffs/terrain, or push enemies into unfavorable positions. Can be used on enemies to push them away from their team or into yours.

cyclone.description: Active: Cyclone target enemy or self for 2.5s. Self-cast provides basic dispel. +20 move speed, +2.5 mana regen.
cyclone.coaching_tip: Self-cast dispels silences, slows, and many debuffs. On enemies, use it to set up skillshots (e.g., Lina stun, Leshrac split) or to disable someone while you reposition.

sphere.description: Passive: Blocks one targeted spell every 12s. Can be transferred to an ally.
sphere.coaching_tip: Best against heroes with single-target initiation like Beastmaster Roar, Legion Commander Duel, or Doom. Transfer it to your carry if they are the primary target.

lotus_orb.description: Active: Dispel target ally and apply Echo Shell for 6s, reflecting targeted spells back at casters.
lotus_orb.coaching_tip: Apply to your core hero before a fight for the dispel plus spell reflect combo. The dispel alone removes debuffs like silences and slows, and the reflect deters enemies from casting on the target.

aeon_disk.description: Passive: When HP drops below 70%, applies strong dispel and 2.5s of damage immunity (CD 105s).
aeon_disk.coaching_tip: Essential for squishy heroes who get burst down instantly. The long cooldown means you only get one chance per fight, so be aware of the timer. Best on supports or initiators who need to survive initial burst.

pipe.description: Active: Grants a 400 magic damage absorbing shield to nearby allies for 12s. Passive: +2 HP regen aura, +4 magic resistance aura.
pipe.coaching_tip: Activate before teamfights when facing heavy magical AoE damage (e.g., Zeus, Tinker, Leshrac). The shield absorbs a flat amount, so using it early before the damage comes is ideal.

mekansm.description: Active: Restore 275 HP to nearby allies (CD 50s). +4 all attributes, +2 armor aura.
mekansm.coaching_tip: Use it mid-fight when your team starts taking damage, not when they are already critically low. The burst heal can swing a teamfight. Build into Guardian Greaves when possible.

crimson_guard.description: Active: Grant nearby allies a damage block shield for 12s. Passive: 60% chance to block 75 damage.
crimson_guard.coaching_tip: Extremely effective against lineups with lots of physical right-click damage or summon/illusion heroes. Activate it at the start of a teamfight for maximum team-wide benefit.

heavens_halberd.description: Active: Disarm target for 3s (melee) or 5s (ranged). +25% evasion, +20 Str, +16% status resistance.
heavens_halberd.coaching_tip: Use the disarm on the enemy carry to shut down their physical damage in fights. It pierces BKB on melee heroes (3s duration) and is one of the best items to counter right-clickers.

spirit_vessel.description: Active on enemy: 4% max HP damage/sec and -45% healing reduction for 8s. Active on ally: 2% max HP heal/sec for 8s. Gains charges on hero kills.
spirit_vessel.coaching_tip: Must-buy against high-sustain heroes like Alchemist, Huskar, Morphling, and Wraith King. The healing reduction is critical. Also useful on allies for sustained healing.

desolator.description: +50 damage. Attacks reduce target armor by 6 for 7s.
desolator.coaching_tip: Great for pushing towers since the armor reduction applies to buildings. Core physical damage item for mid-game timing pushes. Works well with other physical damage dealers on your team.

daedalus.coaching_tip: Pure damage amplifier -- best when you already have sufficient attack speed and base damage. Get attack speed items first, then add Daedalus to multiply your DPS in the late game.

monkey_king_bar.description: +40 damage, +45 attack speed. 75% chance to deal 70 bonus magical damage. Grants True Strike (attacks cannot miss).
monkey_king_bar.coaching_tip: Essential against evasion heroes like Phantom Assassin, Windranger, or anyone who buys Butterfly or Halberd. Without it, you can miss a huge portion of your attacks.

butterfly.description: +35 agility, +35% evasion, +30 attack speed. Active: +20% move speed but lose evasion for 6s.
butterfly.coaching_tip: Powerful late-game item for agi carries, but hard-countered by MKB. Buy it when enemies don't have MKB yet and consider selling it late if they all have True Strike. Use the active to chase or reposition, not mid-fight.

assault.description: +30 attack speed, +10 armor. Aura: +30 attack speed and +5 armor to allies, -5 armor to enemies.
assault.coaching_tip: A team-wide physical damage amplifier. The aura benefits your entire team's right-click damage. Best when your team has multiple physical damage dealers.

skadi.description: +22 all attributes. Attacks apply -20% move speed slow, -35% attack speed slow, and -40% healing/regen reduction for 3s.
skadi.coaching_tip: Exceptional late-game item for its stats and the healing reduction on attacks. The slow and heal-cut stack with Spirit Vessel for maximum anti-heal. Great on any right-click hero in the late game.

heart.description: +250 HP, +45 Str. Passive: Regenerate 1.6% of max HP per second when out of combat for 5s.
heart.coaching_tip: The out-of-combat regen lets you rejoin fights at full HP repeatedly. Disengage when low, wait a few seconds, then re-engage. Best on tanky strength heroes who can absorb sustained damage.

satanic.coaching_tip: Activate Satanic when you're at low HP for a massive heal-through-damage swing. Combine with BKB so you can attack freely during the 6s window without being disabled.

nullifier.description: +65 damage. Active: Continuously dispels the target for 5s and applies a strong slow.
nullifier.coaching_tip: Counters save items like Ghost Scepter, Glimmer Cape, Force Staff, and Aeon Disk by continuously removing their buffs. Essential for carries against enemies who rely on defensive items.

bloodthorn.description: Active: Silence target for 5s. All attacks on silenced target have True Strike and crit for 130%. +30 damage, +75 attack speed.
bloodthorn.coaching_tip: Best against mobile heroes like Storm Spirit, Anti-Mage, Puck, or Ember Spirit. The guaranteed crits make it a team damage multiplier. Upgrade from Orchid when you need more burst.

rapier.description: +350 damage. Drops on death and can be picked up by any hero.
rapier.coaching_tip: Only buy when you're losing and need a comeback or when you're far ahead and can end the game. If you die with it, the enemy gets it. Best on heroes with built-in survivability or AoE to utilize the damage.

mjollnir.description: +24 damage, +70 attack speed. Passive: 30% chance of chain lightning. Active: Place lightning shield on ally.
mjollnir.coaching_tip: Excellent against illusion and summon-heavy lineups since the chain lightning proc hits multiple units. Place the Static Charge shield on your frontline hero who will be attacked the most.

radiance.description: +60 damage. Passive: 60 magical DPS burn aura + 17% miss chance to nearby enemies.
radiance.coaching_tip: Rush this item as fast as possible -- its value decreases the longer the game goes. Best on illusion heroes whose illusions carry the burn aura, maximizing map-wide damage.

diffusal_blade.description: +15 agility, +10 Int. Passive: Attacks burn 40 mana. Active: Slow target by 100% for 4s.
diffusal_blade.coaching_tip: Devastating against low-mana-pool heroes like Wraith King, Medusa, and CK. The active slow is excellent for chasing down kills. Illusion heroes benefit greatly since illusions also burn mana.

silver_edge.description: Active: 14s invisibility. Attacking from invis deals +175 bonus damage and applies Break (disables passives) for 4s.
silver_edge.coaching_tip: The Break effect is crucial against passive-dependent heroes like Bristleback, PA, Spectre, Huskar, and Viper. Plan your initiation around the Break timing.

blink.description: Active: Teleport up to 1200 units instantly. Disabled for 3s upon taking player damage.
blink.coaching_tip: Core initiation item for nearly every hero. It is disabled by player damage, so it is not a reliable escape tool in combat. Initiate with Blink before the enemy can damage you.

shadow_blade.description: Active: 14s invisibility with +20% move speed. Breaking invisibility with an attack deals +175 bonus damage.
shadow_blade.coaching_tip: Good for initiation and escape, but countered by Sentry Wards, Dust, and Gem. Do not rely on it as your only escape. Upgrade to Silver Edge later for the Break effect.

ultimate_scepter.description: +10 all attributes, +175 HP, +175 mana. Upgrades hero's ultimate or grants a new ability.
ultimate_scepter.coaching_tip: Check your hero's Aghanim's upgrade before buying -- some are game-changing, others are marginal. Prioritize it when the upgrade fundamentally changes how your hero plays.

aghanims_shard.description: Unlocks or upgrades an ability (varies by hero). Available after 15 minutes.
aghanims_shard.coaching_tip: Extremely cost-efficient mid-game power spike at 1400 gold. Almost every hero benefits from their Shard upgrade. Buy it at 15 minutes if you have the gold -- it is one of the best value items in the game.

refresher.description: Active: Reset cooldowns of all abilities and items (CD 160s). +12 HP regen, +12 mana regen.
refresher.coaching_tip: Best on heroes with high-impact, long-cooldown ultimates like Enigma, Tidehunter, Warlock, Magnus, and Invoker. Double BKB is also extremely valuable in late game.

sheepstick.description: Active: Hex target enemy for 3.5s (turns them into a critter, silenced/muted/disarmed). +35 Int, +10 Str, +10 Agi.
sheepstick.coaching_tip: The strongest single-target disable item in the game. Use it before the enemy pops BKB. Chain it with other disables for a guaranteed kill. Late-game must-have for intelligence heroes.

rod_of_atos.description: Active: Root target for 2s at 1100 range (CD 18s). +24 Int, +12 Str, +12 Agi.
rod_of_atos.coaching_tip: Long-range initiation tool to lock enemies in place for follow-up spells. Root prevents movement, blink, and TP, but does not prevent attacking or casting. Great on heroes with skillshot stuns.

orchid.description: Active: Silence target for 5s, taking 30% of total damage dealt at the end as bonus magic damage. +40 damage, +30 attack speed.
orchid.coaching_tip: Rush it against spell-dependent heroes like Storm Spirit, Puck, Anti-Mage, or Ember Spirit. The 30% damage amp at the end is significant burst. Upgrade to Bloodthorn for even more damage.

shivas_guard.description: Active: Release freezing wave dealing 200 damage and slowing 40% for 4s. Passive: -45 attack speed aura to enemies. +30 Int, +15 armor.
shivas_guard.coaching_tip: Excellent against physical attack-speed-based lineups. The attack speed reduction aura is constant and passive. Use the active blast at the start of teamfights for the AoE slow.

manta.description: Active: Create 2 illusions and apply basic dispel on self. +26 Agi, +10 Str, +10 Int.
manta.coaching_tip: The basic dispel on activation removes silences, slows, and many debuffs. Use it reactively to dispel, not just to push lanes. Agi carry core item for the dispel, illusions, and stats.

ethereal_blade.description: Active: Target becomes ethereal for 4s (immune to physical, +40% magic damage taken). +40 primary attribute damage.
ethereal_blade.coaching_tip: Combo tool for magic burst heroes -- cast it then follow up with nukes for 40% amplified magic damage. Can also self-cast defensively against physical attackers. Morphling uses it offensively with Adaptive Strike.

aether_lens.coaching_tip: Increases your initiation range, making it easier to land spells from a safe distance. Core on supports who need to stay at the back of fights. Builds into Octarine Core later.

wind_waker.description: Active: Cyclone self, ally, or enemy for 2.5s. Self/ally cyclone provides basic dispel and allows repositioning while airborne. +50 move speed.
wind_waker.coaching_tip: Upgraded Eul's that can save allies. Use it on teammates to buy time or dispel debuffs. The ability to cyclone allies makes it one of the best late-game support items.

gleipnir.description: Active: Root all enemies in an area for 2s (CD 18s). Passive: 30% chance for chain lightning on attack.
gleipnir.coaching_tip: AoE root combined with chain lightning makes this an excellent teamfight initiation tool. The root goes through BKB and prevents movement, blink, and TP. Great on heroes who need AoE control.

ancient_janggo.description: Active: +45 attack speed and +13% move speed to nearby allies for 6s (CD 30s). +7 all attributes.
ancient_janggo.coaching_tip: Cost-effective mid-game aura item for push-oriented lineups. Use the active during pushes and teamfights. Great early team item, but sell it later when inventory space is needed.

holy_locket.description: Active: Release stored charges to heal a target. Passive: +35% heal and regen amplification. +3 all attributes, +250 HP, +250 mana.
holy_locket.coaching_tip: Core for healing-oriented supports like Dazzle, Chen, Warlock, Omniknight, and Oracle. The 35% heal amp affects all heals and regeneration you provide to allies.

veil_of_discord.description: Active: Weaken enemies in an area, reducing their magic resistance by 18% for 16s. +5 all attributes, +5 armor.
veil_of_discord.coaching_tip: Use it on grouped enemies before your team unleashes magic damage. Great in magic-heavy lineups. Apply it at the start of fights to amplify all your team's magical burst.

abyssal_blade.description: Active: Stun target for 2s through spell immunity (CD 35s). Passive: 25% bash chance for 1.5s stun. +250 HP, +10 damage.
abyssal_blade.coaching_tip: The active stun pierces BKB, making it the go-to lockdown for carries against BKB carriers. Use the active stun on priority targets who have already used BKB. Blink + Abyssal is a reliable kill combo.

bfury.description: +60 damage, +7.5 HP regen, +2.75 mana regen. Passive: 70% melee cleave in 650 AoE. +Quelling Bonus.
bfury.coaching_tip: A farming accelerator -- buy it early to speed up your farm. The cleave lets you clear jungle camps and creep waves rapidly. Best on heroes who can fight with it later (PA crits cleave, Ember Sleight).

armlet.description: Toggle: +25 Str, +35 damage, +4 armor while draining 54 HP/sec. +5 armor, +25 attack speed when inactive.
armlet.coaching_tip: Master the Armlet toggle technique -- quickly toggling off and on gives you a burst of 500 HP. Toggle it on before fights and off between fights. Huskar's passive synergizes perfectly with the HP drain.

echo_sabre.description: +15 damage, +13 Str, +10 Int, +1.75 mana regen. Passive: Double attack on first hit (CD 6s), second hit slows 100% for 0.7s.
echo_sabre.coaching_tip: The double attack is excellent for burst damage and applying on-hit effects twice. Great on Slark for double Essence Shift stacks. Disassembles into BKB and Orchid/Harpoon components later.

hand_of_midas.description: Active: Kill a non-hero unit for 160 gold and 2.1x XP (CD 90s). +40 attack speed.
hand_of_midas.coaching_tip: Buy before 15 minutes or not at all -- it needs time to pay off. Use it on the highest-level creep available (large jungle creeps) for maximum XP. Do not skip it just because you had a good lane; it ensures late-game scaling.

blade_mail.description: Active: Return 80% of damage taken for 5.5s. +7 armor, +28 damage.
blade_mail.coaching_tip: Force enemies to choose: attack you and take damage back, or switch targets. Best on initiators who jump into the enemy team (Axe, Legion Commander, Centaur). Activate it right as you engage.

dagon.coaching_tip: Burst magic damage for pickoffs and snowballing. Most effective in the early-mid game when enemy HP pools are small. Falls off hard in late game. Combine with Ethereal Blade for maximum burst damage.

maelstrom.description: +24 damage. Passive: 30% chance on attack to release chain lightning hitting 4 targets for 140 damage.
maelstrom.coaching_tip: A mid-game farming item and teamfight damage multiplier. Works on ranged and melee heroes alike. Builds into Mjollnir or Gleipnir. Great for heroes who need AoE damage to farm faster.

khanda.description: +50 damage. Passive: After casting a spell, next attack within 6s crits for 160%. Also grants spell damage crit (140% on ability damage, CD 12s).
khanda.coaching_tip: Best on heroes who weave spells between attacks. The spell crit procs on ability damage, making it excellent for heroes like Pangolier (Swashbuckle) or Ember (Sleight of Fist).

disperser.description: Active on self/ally: Basic dispel + 100% move speed for 4s. Active on enemy: Slow 100% for 4s. +40 damage, +40 attack speed.
disperser.coaching_tip: Upgraded Diffusal Blade with a powerful dispel. Self-cast to dispel debuffs and gain max move speed for chasing or escaping. Cast on enemies for a crippling slow. Extremely versatile.

harpoon.description: Active: Pull yourself to the target enemy hero (CD 18s). +24 damage, +15 Str, +10 Int.
harpoon.coaching_tip: Gap-closer for melee carries who struggle to get on top of targets. Use it to catch fleeing heroes or close the distance to start fighting. Builds from Echo Sabre components.

parasma.description: +24 damage, +200 mana. Passive: Attacks deal bonus magic damage equal to 80% of your Int. Spells apply magic damage amplification debuff.
parasma.coaching_tip: Powerful on Int heroes who auto-attack frequently. The spell debuff amplifies follow-up magic damage, making it excellent for heroes who chain spells and right-clicks together.

basher.description: +25 damage. Passive: 25% bash chance for melee (10% ranged) dealing 100 bonus damage and 1.5s stun. CD 2.3s.
basher.coaching_tip: Locks down targets with repeated stuns. Best on fast-attacking melee heroes who proc the bash often. Upgrade to Abyssal Blade for the guaranteed BKB-piercing active stun.

eternal_shroud.description: +8.5 HP regen, +20% magic resistance. Passive: 25% spell lifesteal. Active: Gain a barrier that absorbs 400 magic damage for 12s.
eternal_shroud.coaching_tip: Combine magic resistance with spell lifesteal for incredible sustainability. The active barrier stacks with Pipe for massive magic damage absorption. Best on frontline heroes who deal AoE spell damage.

mage_slayer.description: +20 damage, +20% magic resistance. Passive: Attacks place a debuff reducing the target's spell damage by 35% for 6s.
mage_slayer.coaching_tip: Hard counter to spell-dependent cores. Attack the enemy caster to reduce their spell damage output by 35%. Particularly effective on illusion heroes since illusions also apply the debuff.

bloodstone.description: +450 HP, +425 mana, +3 mana regen. Passive: 30% spell lifesteal. Active: Sacrifice 50% current HP to restore that amount as mana.
bloodstone.coaching_tip: Core on mana-hungry spell casters who deal sustained damage. The spell lifesteal keeps you alive during extended fights. Storm Spirit's Ball Lightning and Leshrac's Pulse Nova both benefit enormously.

wraith_pact.description: Active: Summon a totem that reduces all enemy damage dealt by 30% and deals DPS in a 900 AoE. +2 all attributes, +2 armor aura.
wraith_pact.coaching_tip: The 30% damage reduction to enemies is massive in teamfights. Place the totem in a position where enemies cannot easily destroy it but it still covers the fight zone. One of the most impactful aura items.

hurricane_pike.description: Active: Push self and target 450 units apart, gaining 4 attacks on the target with unlimited range. +15 Agi, +13 Str, +150 HP.
hurricane_pike.coaching_tip: Upgraded Force Staff for ranged carries and supports. The active pushes you away from the enemy while granting 4 unlimited-range attacks -- perfect for kiting melee heroes. Also works as an escape tool.

solar_crest.description: Active on ally: +6 armor, +60 attack speed, +10% move speed. Active on enemy: -6 armor, -60 attack speed, -10% move speed. Duration 12s.
solar_crest.coaching_tip: Incredibly versatile: buff your carry before a fight or debuff the enemy carry. Also works on Roshan to speed up the kill. One of the most cost-effective items for supports.

meteor_hammer.description: Active: Channel 0.5s, then stun and deal damage in AoE for 6s. Damages buildings. +12 Str, +12 Int, +6 HP regen, +6 mana regen.
meteor_hammer.coaching_tip: The channeling time requires a setup stun or from fog of war. Can hit buildings, making it useful for split-pushing. Chain it off reliable disables for guaranteed damage and stun.

octarine_core.description: +625 mana, +3.5 mana regen. Passive: -25% cooldown reduction on abilities and items.
octarine_core.coaching_tip: The 25% cooldown reduction affects everything -- abilities, items, and even BKB. Best on heroes who spam abilities frequently. The CDR on items like Blink Dagger and BKB is especially valuable.

moon_shard.description: +140 attack speed. Can be consumed for a permanent +60 attack speed buff.
moon_shard.coaching_tip: Consume it when you are six-slotted for a permanent 60 attack speed bonus that does not take an inventory slot. Buy it for the 140 attack speed boost when you need raw DPS in the late game.

vladmir.description: Passive aura: +18% lifesteal, +18% bonus damage, +3 armor, +1.75 mana regen to nearby allies.
vladmir.coaching_tip: An efficient team aura item that benefits all allies. The percentage-based damage and lifesteal scale well into the late game. Great on melee offlaners or supports who stay near the team.

helm_of_the_overlord.description: Active: Dominate a creep (up to Ancient-level) permanently. Aura: +8 armor, +200 HP to dominated units. +7 all attributes, +7 HP regen, +7 armor.
helm_of_the_overlord.coaching_tip: Dominate an Ancient creep for powerful auras or abilities (e.g., Thunderhide for attack speed aura, Granite Golem for HP aura). The dominated creep can push lanes and scout. Micro-intensive but extremely rewarding.

boots_of_bearing.description: Active: Grant nearby allies +50 attack speed and +15% move speed for 6s, with a 1.5s undispellable effect. +200 HP, +200 mana.
boots_of_bearing.coaching_tip: Upgraded Drum of Endurance with a more powerful active. The undispellable initial burst of speed allows your team to engage or disengage even against slows. Great for push-oriented and teamfight-centric strategies.

witch_blade.description: +35 Int, +6 armor. Passive: Attacks deal bonus magic damage based on Int and apply a 25% slow for 4s (CD 9s).
witch_blade.coaching_tip: Cost-effective damage item for Int heroes who right-click often. The slow and bonus damage proc helps with laning and pickoffs. Falls off late game, so consider upgrading or selling.

phylactery.description: +7 all attributes, +200 HP, +200 mana, +4 mana regen. Passive: After casting, next damaging spell deals 150 bonus magic damage (CD 6s).
phylactery.coaching_tip: Budget burst damage amplifier for spell-focused heroes. The 150 bonus damage procs reliably with low-cooldown spells. Excellent mid-game pickup for supports who need more damage output.

kaya_and_sange.description: +16 Str, +16 Int, +16% spell amp, +16% status resistance, +16% HP regen amp, +16% mana regen amp.
kaya_and_sange.coaching_tip: Best on spell-casting cores who also need survivability. The status resistance helps you escape disables faster, while the spell amplification boosts your damage. Ideal for front-line casters.

sange_and_yasha.description: +16 Str, +16 Agi, +16% status resistance, +16% move speed, +16% HP regen amp, +16% lifesteal amp.
sange_and_yasha.coaching_tip: A well-rounded fighting item for melee carries. The status resistance means stuns and slows last shorter on you, which is crucial for heroes who need to stay on targets. Good mid-game timing item.

yasha_and_kaya.description: +16 Agi, +16 Int, +16% spell amp, +16% move speed, +16% mana regen amp, +16% spell lifesteal amp.
yasha_and_kaya.coaching_tip: Ideal for mobile, spell-heavy cores who also benefit from attack speed. The move speed and spell amp combination suits heroes who weave in and out of fights, like Storm Spirit or Ember Spirit.

arcane_blink.description: Active: Blink up to 1200 units. After blinking, -50% cast point and +25% debuff duration for 6s. +25 Int.
arcane_blink.coaching_tip: The cast point reduction after blinking lets you land big ultimates faster. Enigma's Black Hole, Magnus's Reverse Polarity, and Tidehunter's Ravage all become nearly instant. Best Blink upgrade for initiators.

overwhelming_blink.description: Active: Blink up to 1200 units. On landing, deal 100 + 150% Str as damage, slow enemies by 50% for 1.25s in AoE. +25 Str.
overwhelming_blink.coaching_tip: Adds AoE damage and slow on your Blink initiation. Best on strength initiators who jump into the enemy team. The slow gives your team time to follow up on your initiation.

swift_blink.description: Active: Blink up to 1200 units. After blinking, +30% phased move speed, +40 damage, and +40 attack speed for 6s. +25 Agi.
swift_blink.coaching_tip: The agility hero's Blink upgrade. The post-blink bonus damage and attack speed are ideal for carries who blink in to burst a target. Excellent on heroes who already use Blink offensively.
